scope: Real RouteALifecycleAdapter plus RouteAMergeBoundary plus the test-scope RTL2.4.1 provider. No production-top provider, numeric datapath, source scheduling/packets, model, GPU, timing, throughput, PPA, or new A4 DSE.

ownership.active_observation: RouteAMergeBoundary solely owns; provider reads without ready/backpressure
ownership.result_fault_offer: testbench-only provider owns exactly one success XOR fault offer

harness_stimulus_boundary: merge_ready is an explicit already-completed canonical source-set test event. It is not a source plan, source packet, source release, scheduler, endpoint, or production ingress.
directed_coverage: matching success reaches one R6 outward terminal and is stable while attention_terminal ready is low
stale scenario is rejected without an outward terminal; matching numeric fault reaches one R6 fault terminal
destructive reset after provider acceptance prevents an outward terminal
deferred: R4 numeric datapath, exp, precision, partial softmax, online merge, and numeric correctness
production top integration or provider instantiation
source packet production, scheduling, release, authority/publication/page behavior
physical controller/macro, cycle, timing, throughput, deadlock, area, energy, and PPA

tests.coverage: isolated provider, R4 observation/boundary, R4-R6 terminal chain, and production-top structural regression

evidence_boundary: no numeric correctness, cycle, timing, throughput, deadlock-freedom, area, energy, PPA, or RTL system correctness claim
